related_memories.content: Reviewer note (second-pass, .github/workflows/master-agent-dispatch.yaml + .github/CLAUDE.md ...): Reviewed the move of all seven master-agent-dispatch jobs ...
Reviewed PR #477 (branch ci/consolidation-qa-job) which adds a consolidation-qa job to Master Agent Dispatch ...

answer:
Master Agent Dispatch runs the following QA rounds (per `.github/CLAUDE.md:838`):

- `doc-qa` (Quality Assurance)  
- `defect-hunt`  
- `coverage-qa`  
- `consolidation-qa`  
- `performance-qa`  
- `pdsl-qa`  

The branch prefixes for these QA rounds are derived from their names: `qa/doc-qa`, `qa/defect-hunt`, `qa/coverage`, `qa/consolidation`, `qa/performance`, and `qa/pdsl` (per `qa-cadence.sh` convention and `tools/ci/README.md:23`, which documents `qa-cadence.sh` uses `BRANCH_PREFIX` to decide cadence).

The open-PR limit is controlled by `MAX_OPEN_PRS`, used by `open-pr-backlog.sh` (shared by both planning jobs per `tools/ci/README.md:23`). While the exact numeric value isn’t stated in the provided chunks, the script’s purpose is to “decide whether the open-PR backlog leaves room for a planning round” — implying it enforces a threshold before allowing dispatch.

No code example for `MAX_OPEN_PRS` is provided in the chunks, but the script usage is referenced.
